fields.title: Agree a budget transfer for Sales EMEA’s early hires
fields.cause: Three account executives started four months ahead of plan and the offices opened early; the year runs $572K over.
fields.plan: Move $350K from Sales NA’s unused enablement budget; freeze the remaining EMEA discretionary spend until year end; re-forecast on Dec 1.

fields.title: Cap paid search at plan for November and December
fields.cause: Paid search ran 40% over plan for two months, and three sponsorships were booked without a budget line.
fields.plan: Set daily caps at the plan rate; ask the CFO to approve or cancel the three sponsorship POs; re-forecast after the cap.

fields.title: Refresh the Data & AI forecast and decide on the GPU reservation
fields.cause: The forecast is 33 days old while GPU usage tripled; PO-8870 reserves Q1 capacity with no budget line.
fields.plan: Re-run the forecast with November usage; compare the reservation with January’s expected price cut; bring both to the Thursday spend review.

fields.title: Decide the three IT renewals before Dec 1
fields.cause: Three SaaS contracts worth $410K renew within 60 days with no decision.
fields.plan: Pull seat usage for each; propose renew, cut seats or switch; get the COO’s decision before notice periods close.

fields.title: Refresh the Legal and Facilities forecasts
fields.cause: Both forecasts are more than 30 days old.
fields.plan: Update with October actuals and open POs; confirm the Austin lease assumption with Facilities.

fields.title: Attach budget lines to Brand & Events’ two open POs
fields.cause: Two agency POs went out without a budget line.
fields.plan: Done on Nov 10 for the video agency; the swag PO is waiting for the vendor’s revised quote.
